messages.en:
{07 14 00}I like having a few fish
around to keep me company
at home, {04 1f 00}.
Even if I don't have any
friends, {07 09 00}I can always talk
to my fishies, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib, kui kodus on
paar kala, kes mulle
seltsi pakuvad, {04 1f 00}.
Isegi kui mul pole sõpru,
{07 09 00}saan ma alati oma kaladega
rääkida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I put a ton of fish tanks
in my room!
 
{07 17 00}I think it finally looks
like a professional
aquarium!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma panin oma tuppa tonni
akvaariume!
 
{07 17 00}Ma arvan, et see näeb
lõpuks välja nagu
professionaalne akvaarium!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}My room looks good, and it
smells great! Nothing like
fish to freshen a place!
{07 0d 00}And the more you have,
the better it smells! It's
amazing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mu tuba näeb hea välja ja
lõhnab suurepäraselt!
Kala värskendab kohta!
{07 0d 00}Ja mida rohkem neid on,
seda parem lõhn! See on
hämmastav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
